thread:
Omar: Heads-up 6mdash; OrionHealth indicated they'll sign if POC shows <300ms p50 and can sustain 150qps steady with short 5m spikes to 450qps. They also asked for a capacity runbook and pricing scenarios.
Jin: Got it. Do we have their traffic mix? chat vs embeddings vs rerank?
Omar: Sales notes: 70% chat generation, 20% embeddings, 10% rerank. Avg tokens per chat ~160, rerank small.
Nora: For capacity, embeddings are CPU-heavy for batch, but we handle them on GPU for speed. Bursts to 450qps will demand parallel replicas + KV caching.
Priya: Compliance: they require SAML SSO, customer KMS (bring-your-own-key), and a signed DPA. Also asked about log retention and redaction controls.
Ravi: Mapping from qps to GPUs: ballpark, one V100-like card does ~60qps for gen with 512 context under our profiles. For their 150qps steady, reserved 3 GPUs gives headroom; for spikes to 450qps we need up to 8 GPUs if no batching improvements.
Jin: Recommend we offer two options: low-commit (2 reserved GPUs + burst credits up to 6 GPUs) and commit (4 reserved GPUs with deeper discount). Include quantized model option for burst handling.
Nora: Operational runbook: preheat KV cache, set autoscale policy, and include canary rollback. Preheat suggestion: run synthetic sessions targeting the most common prefixes to populate KV. Example command:
Nora: ```bash
k6 run --vus 40 --duration 8m ./preheat_orion.js
```
Priya: Flag: SSO timeline is blocking. Orion insists SAML must be live before POC start. Security engineering lead says SAML onboarding is typically 4-5 business days; we can fast-track to 2 if we get their IdP metadata now. I'll request support.
Omar: Pricing ask: Orion wants price sensitivity - will they get 25% off reserved if they commit 12 months? Sales asked for a tiered discount schedule.
Jin: Finance input: standard tiers: 15% for 6mo, 25% for 12mo with minimum 4 GPU-equivalent reserved. For a 4-GPU reserve, propose 25% off compute hours and 10% off burst credits.
Ravi: Autoscale policy suggestion: scale_up when avg queue > 100 requests over 30s, add replicas in steps of 2 up to burst cap. Scale_down when queue < 40 for 5m. Prefer rapid scale-up to meet p50 SLA. Use spot for overflow but exclude from KMS-bound workloads.
Nora: Also add a rate-limiter rule for public endpoints: cap per-team QPS to 120 so that noisy sources don't exhaust burst pool during spikes.
Priya: Compliance items to deliver: signed DPA template, subprocessor list, KMS integration doc, and SSO checklist. I'll assemble and send to Orion by EOD if they provide IdP metadata.
Omar: Quality control: we need a guardrail if quantized model produces regression on their eval set. Plan: run canary on 5% of traffic, scoreboard eval, auto-fallback to FP model if metric delta > 2%.
Jin: For the POC schedule: week 0 integration and SSO; week 1 preheat + smoke; week 2 load ramp and quality evaluation. Include a daily telemetry digest for Orion with p50/p95, tokens/day, and cost estimates.
Ravi: Preheat sizing: for each reserved GPU run a 10-minute preheat workload at 30 concurrent sessions to populate KV. Make sure the job posts a deploy event.
Deploy-bot: Noted. Preheat job scheduled to run on staging 2026-01-15T22:00:00Z. Owner: @ravi.
Omar: Action items: (1) Jin to draft pricing matrix for 2/3/4 GPU reserve + burst credits, (2) Priya to start SSO/KMS docs and DPA, (3) Ravi to prepare k6 preheat script and staging job, (4) Nora to draft autoscale/runbook one-pager.
Jin: I'll ping finance and have numbers by tomorrow morning.
Priya: Starting SSO intake now; sending the IdP checklist to Orion.
Ravi: I'll drop the preheat script in git and link in this thread when ready.
Nora: I'll sketch the one-pager and include diagrams for reserved vs burst flow.
Omar: Scheduling presales sync with Orion and eng for tomorrow 11:00 PT. I'll send invite.
Nora: Quick FYI: if Orion needs strict AZ pinning for KMS, we should suggest Dedicated with customer KMS attached — Private can do it but may need extra lead time.
Omar: Thanks. If SSO stalls, we push POC until SAML is validated. Marking this thread pending until SSO confirmation. :white_check_mark:
